description: Mapped-instance count for the SAME committed klt synthesize request (../20260924-134500-1a8313b/synth-request.json) on the SAME frozen RTL (../20260923-093000-28a7c96/candidates/rtl/modexp-bit-serial.v), across every publicly installable Yosys build tried. Each row's `wasm_sha256` is the sha256 of yowasp_yosys/yosys.wasm -- the single WebAssembly module that contains Yosys and its embedded abc -- which is the mapper build identity `yosys -V` does not report. Same klt (0.6.0+gc66f18fd6225), same PDK, same host, same request: the only variable is the mapper build.

target.question: is 1204 reachable from any publicly installable Yosys build?
target.answer: not from any build tried here -- see `builds` below

builds.note: THE PIN (scripts/setup-env.sh). Run twice here and twice more by rerun-pinned-synthesis.sh; all four runs identical, netlist sha256 d0785125176bc27c95adaffd25cb82dbb46da9038dfb63d5df39d7f3fb5404f7.

not_re_derived_here.source: Homebrew Yosys 0.69+post (git sha1 143eb14f9cc55d6f8927e68523b0c9d2166ed02c), macOS arm64, native
not_re_derived_here.note: Reported in a comment on issue #143 by the issue #141 Builder pass, run against the frozen yosys-cell-exclusion.ys directly rather than through klt. Cited as a sixth, differently-built data point; it is an issue comment, not an artifact of this record, and this record does not stand on it.

conclusion: Five distinct publicly installable mapper builds (five distinct wasm digests) produce 1139 or 1105 instances. None produces 1204. The frozen row 5/6 figure of 1204 is therefore not reachable from any publicly installable Yosys build tried, and is treated as an artifact of the build on the host that produced record 20260923-093000-28a7c96's candidate rows.
